authority.notes: Conservative machine-readable baseline derived only from already-approved A PRASA editorial/community standards and established publication precedents. Project 04 may implement and validate this specification but may not create new editorial policy. Default HOLD is intentional for unrepresented or ambiguous cases.

rules.description: Ordinary cultural, community, public-interest or general-audience activity may be editorially selected when the activity is within geographic scope, materially current, sufficiently evidenced, and no exclusion rule applies.
rules.authority_note: Eligibility is activity-based and viewpoint-neutral; organizer identity alone is not an exclusion basis.

rules.description: Worship or proselytizing activity is outside the ordinary A PRASA Things to Do editorial scope.
rules.authority_note: A PRASA is general-audience and nonsectarian.

rules.description: Partisan campaigns or ideological rallies are outside the ordinary A PRASA Things to Do editorial scope.
rules.authority_note: A PRASA is nonpartisan and not an advocacy platform.

rules.description: Explicit adult entertainment is outside the ordinary A PRASA Things to Do editorial scope.
rules.authority_note: A PRASA's ordinary public square is general-audience.

rules.description: Hate or extremist activity is outside the ordinary A PRASA Things to Do editorial scope.
rules.authority_note: Payment or organizer identity cannot override this exclusion.

rules.description: Unlawful or materially unsafe activity is outside the ordinary A PRASA Things to Do editorial scope.
rules.authority_note: Where legality or safety is genuinely uncertain rather than established, use HOLD instead of guessing.

rules.description: A material unresolved conflict between credible sources blocks selection until the conflict is resolved or governed.
rules.authority_note: First route to evidence verification. Escalate only if the conflict remains unresolved or creates a novel policy question.

rules.description: First-party organizer, venue or provider sources are preferred for event availability and material details when accessible; corroborating sources may support but do not authorize invention.
rules.authority_note: This is an evidence-handling rule, not an automatic selection rule.

rules.description: Missing admission information does not make an otherwise eligible event unpublishable and must never be inferred as free.
rules.authority_note: Do not infer free admission, ticket price, booking requirement, reservation requirement or access procedure.

rules.description: A cultural, community or public-interest event does not become ineligible merely because it is ticketed or hosted by a commercial venue.
rules.authority_note: Editorial eligibility remains independent of commercial relationships.

rules.description: Payment or a commercial relationship cannot buy ordinary editorial inclusion, ranking, verification, endorsement, favorable treatment or exemption from standards.
rules.authority_note: Apply the same eligibility and evidence rules regardless of client or sponsor status.

rules.description: A primary proposition that is an ongoing tour, excursion, class, experience or service belongs to commercial-promotion classification rather than ordinary editorial Things to Do processing.
rules.authority_note: The editorial/commercial boundary is approved, but Sponsored Spotlight pricing and complete automated commercial-publication treatment remain unresolved. Do not automate paid-placement decisions from this rule.

rules.description: A candidate that has fully ended before publication must not be introduced as current Things to Do content.
rules.authority_note: Currentness is evaluated from governed event dates; checked_at age alone is not an expiry signal.

rules.description: Project 04 automation may not invent facts, editorial rules, localization, media rights, commercial policy or governance to complete a candidate.
rules.authority_note: Route to the owning authority or evidence/localization/media worker first; founder escalation is reserved for genuine unresolved governance exceptions.
